title: OH Lord we thy children are here again

lines.text: OH Lord we thy children are here again
Thine mercy all we seek
On this our harvest anniversary day
Thine mercy all we plead.
Merry, merry, merry we plead Thee
Holy Father God above
Thine window of blessings open to us
On us Thine mercies rain.
Christ Jesus Lord everyday perpetual
Merciful Thou art Lord
The lame and physically handicapped
Mercy from thee receive.
This running year, Oh Lord our God we plead May we not be in want
And bless thou all our business endeavours
Convenient we shall live.
Save us Oh Lord from the pangs of Satan
Through all our sojourn here
And keep death and all afflictions away
Lord our life span prolong.
Oh Lord God all our sins we plead forgive
In all that Thee we grief
We plead yield unto us repentant heart
That we may be all Thine.
When the harvest of latterdays shall come
And all our souls are reaped
Just like the wheat into heavenly barn
With mercy accept us.
